Exige sesión con alguno de los roles SYSTEM, RETRIEVAL_WORKER, PLATFORM_ADMIN. Valida el cuerpo como `RankCandidatesDto` (6 campos, 3 obligatorios). Delega en `RetrievalService.rankCandidates`. Crea filas en messaging.domain_events, messaging.outbox_messages, vector_rag.retrieval_candidates. Actualiza vector_rag.retrieval_sessions. Lee messaging.outbox_messages, vector_rag.rag_access_policies, vector_rag.retrieval_sessions, vector_rag.vector_chunks, vector_rag.vector_collections, vector_rag.vector_documents. Publica RetrievalCandidatesRanked.
